text:
maria: Heads up — kicking off bring-up for ap-southeast3 (new region) next week. Need GPU quota bump, temporary capacity reservation for onboarding, and network priming. Who can own the provider quota request and reservation?

ajay: I can take the quota request. What's the exact SKU and target numbers?

maria: Target is 32 prod GPUs (A100-equivalent) + 8 validation GPUs. Prefer 80GB class but vendor equivalents ok. Launch target: Mon Apr 6 2026. Current soft quota is 16/gpu per project in that region.

ajay: Cool. I'll open a ticket with cloud provider. Need project list, billing account, and expected burn.

maria: Project list: infra-prod, infra-staging, infra-validate. Billing account: rbwd-main-billing. Estimated committed spend for reserved period ~ $48k/mo if we keep baseline; add burst headroom for first 48h ~ $6k.

samir: Network preflight: ensure VPC peering across pe-ap-svc, setup private service connect for control plane, and a firewall rule allowing management CIDR 10.20.0.0/22. Also confirm MTU (some vendors default 1460, we need 1500).

ajay: Noted. I'll include network checklist in the provider request and cc @cloud-sales for quota prioritization.

cloud-sales: Thanks, Ajay — send provider support the following template. We'll escalate for faster approval if you mark it as "bring-up critical".

cloud-sales (code): ```
Quota Request Template:
- project_ids: [infra-prod, infra-staging, infra-validate]
- region: ap-southeast3
- resource: GPUS
- sku: A100_80GB or equivalent
- quantity: 40 (32 prod + 8 validation)
- start_time: 2026-04-04T00:00Z
- end_time: 2026-06-04T00:00Z
- justification: initial cluster bring-up, warm pool for CI, require reservation and ability to burst for 48h
- contact_emails: ops@redwood.com, infra-oncall@redwood.com
```

maria: Also requirement: tag reservations with "bringup-apse3-196789" and enable preemptible fallback list. We want a dedicated reservation pool (not shared) for first 72 hours.

ajay: Opening provider ticket now. Ticket ID: PROVIDER-48219. Adding details and attaching the quota template.

cloud-bot: Ticket PROVIDER-48219 created; status: pending. ETA from provider: 3 business days unless escalated. Reaction: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samir: For our internal runbook, add a validation probe: deploy small model, run perf smoke (p95 < 160ms for 128-token gen), KV cache warming test, and cross-AZ routing check. I'll paste probes after lunch.

maria: Perfect. Who will handle the reservation (commit + billing handshake)? Ajay? Or finance?

finance-bot: Confirming budget pre-approval for temporary reserved capacity up to $60k for the 30-day bring-up window. Please tag invoices with cost_center: infra-bringup-apse3.

ajay: I'll coordinate with finance and cloud-sales for the reservation contract. Plan: request quota increase first, then request a short reservation/commit for the bring-up window. If provider pushes back, request burst quota and preemption policy.

oncall-sre: I'll take the handoff test window. Put me down for Wed 2026-04-08 02:00-04:00 UTC for smoke + failover drills. Notify infra-oncall 24h prior.

maria: Thanks all — Ajay please update PROVIDER-48219 with the network checklist and tag the ticket "bringup-critical". Samir paste the validation probes in this thread when ready.

ajay: Will do. Updating ticket now.

samir: Pasting quick probe list: 
1) small-model load (8 concurrent) -> p95 token latency target 160ms
2) KV cache hit rate > 70% after warmup
3) inter-AZ latency < 2ms baseline
4) docker image pull test from regional registry
5) firewall and PSVpc endpoints verified

maria: Great, closing the planning sync. We'll reconvene after provider confirms quota. :thumbsup:
